title: Three disjoint doublings for two theta prime races
description:
Three common starting heights reproduce four prescribed level and move targets on the 547/727 and 571/599 fields. One start is an integer, the doublings are disjoint and every weight exceeds 1/400. In the finite window a direct prime count proves the result unconditionally. For exact balance one of the starts is 13,471. Recurrence on arbitrarily late windows uses the critical-line theorem for sixteen primitive Dirichlet factors.

Proof, target box and hypotheses.
